messages:
sophie: Heads-up — deploybot failed verification for canary promote (payment-svc). Blocking promotion.
sophie: Logs: helm template -> manifest validation failed; image tag mismatch + chart lint schema error.

deploy-bot: [deploy attempt] service=payment-svc sha=abc123 canary=false result=FAILED reason=manifest-validation error="values.image.tag 'latest' != pinned tag '2026-03-21-rc3'" job_id=db-7891

jamal: On it. Pulling the deploy logs now.
jamal: I can reproduce the manifest error locally — helm template shows image.tag set by pipeline to `latest`, but k8s admission expects pinned tags per policy.

ops-ci: Noted — we had cache evictions in eu-west during last night maintenance. Some artifact layers failed to upload completely; registry returned intermittent 404s for blobs. Could explain why the pipeline fell back to `latest`.

leah: Do we want to hotfix chart lint rules or pin the image back to last-good and rerun canary?
matt: Chart linter failure looks like schema mismatch: resources.requests are strings in values.yaml ("100m"). Linter expects numeric (100m is fine but linter is strict). We could relax linter but that's risky in a release window.

jamal: Agreed — safer to pin image to last-known-good tag and re-run. Hotfixing linter may introduce drift across services.

sophie: Decision proposal: pin payment-svc image -> `2026-03-18-release.7`, re-run canary job, and if green promote. If canary fails again, roll back the promo decision and open an incident.

leah: +1 for pin. Who will create the rollpin? We need an entry in release notes and notify PMs.

jamal: Creating the rollpin now. Patch branch: release-pin/payment-svc-image -> setting tag to 2026-03-18-release.7. Triggering deploybot retry.

deploy-bot: queued retry job id=db-7892 for service=payment-svc env=canary triggered_by=jamal

release-bot: Change window closes at 23:00 UTC but emergency pins allowed. Please add a short blurb under Release Notes: "Pinned payment-svc to last-good image due to artifact registry partial uploads; will regen artifacts and rerun full release verification." I'll auto-add the note when PR merges.

ops-ci: I'll follow up on registry blob issues — will check s3 multipart upload logs and restart the registry replication. ETA 45m.

matt: Once canary passes, let's schedule a brief post-mortem to decide whether to relax linter or update CI to fail earlier on artifact upload errors.

sophie: Thanks team. Tagging PMs in #product-notifs and will update the release tracker. :thumbsup:

jamal: update: db-7892 completed successfully (canary green). Proceeding to promote to staging when I get confirmation from release-bot.

deploy-bot: promotion queued job id=db-7893 status=IN_PROGRESS

deploy-bot: promotion completed job id=db-7893 status=SUCCEEDED

sophie: Promotion done. Release notes updated. Closing thread unless someone objects.
leah: All good from my side. :white_check_mark:
